title: poa arctica f. neophora
intro: Poa arctica f. neophora, commonly known as Arctic Bluegrass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. Additionally, Arctic Bluegrass has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including wounds, respiratory problems, and digestive issues, although more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness.
